def transform(grid):
    # Copy the non-background pattern from the populated panel into every panel.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Divider rows/columns are solid color 2; identify them.
    divr = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(x == 2 for x in row)]
    divc = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))]
    rbounds = [-1] + divr + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + divc + [w]
    panels = [(rbounds[i]+1,rbounds[i+1],cbounds[j]+1,cbounds[j+1]) for i in range(len(rbounds)-1) for j in range(len(cbounds)-1)]
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(row.count(x) for row in grid))
    # locate panel containing most non-background marks
    source = max(panels, key=lambda q: sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(q[0],q[1]) for c in range(q[2],q[3])))
    sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1=source
    pattern=[[grid[r][c] for c in range(sc0,sc1)] for r in range(sr0,sr1)]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in panels:
        for dr in range(min(r1-r0,sr1-sr0)):
            for dc in range(min(c1-c0,sc1-sc0)):
                out[r0+dr][c0+dc]=pattern[dr][dc]
    return out
